step1_analysis.description: This circuit senses the common-mode voltage of a differential pair via two parallel PMOS transistors and compares it against a reference current to generate a feedback control voltage at the diode-connected output node. It is typically used to stabilize the common-mode level in fully differential amplifiers.

paper_reference.title: SAW-Less Analog Front-End Receivers for TDD and FDD

sky130_expected.reasoning: System level metric for the entire receiver, cannot be simulated with this CMFB sub-circuit alone.

cm_gain.description: Common-mode voltage gain of the CMFB detector

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = -gm2 / (gm1 + gm4). With V_CM=1.2V and V_BIAS=0.6V, gm2 ~ 90uS, gm1 ~ 185uS. Gain ~ 20*log10(90/185) = -6.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the ratio of transconductances of the sensing PMOS and the diode-connected PMOS.

sky130_expected.calculation: Differential signals cancel out at the common drain node N0. Gain is ideally 0 (linear), limited by device mismatches which are not modeled in standard TT simulation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Perfect symmetry in the schematic leads to near-infinite rejection in nominal SPICE simulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at N0. R_out ~ 1/(2*gm1 + 2*gm4) ~ 1.5 kOhm. C_out ~ 8 * Cgs ~ 100 fF. BW = 1 / (2*pi*R*C) ~ 1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The output node is low impedance (diode-connected loads), pushing the pole to very high frequencies.

dc_power.description: DC power consumption of the CMFB circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail set by NMOS bias N1=0.6V. I_NMOS ~ 2 * 43uA = 86uA. Total power = VDD * I_total = 1.8V * 86uA = 155 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen bias voltage N1.

sky130_expected.calculation: V(N0) settles to supply the required PMOS current. I_PMOS_diode = 86uA - 16uA = 70uA. V_OV1 ~ 0.37V. V(N0) = 1.8 - 0.42 - 0.37 = 1.01V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Self-biasing node that adjusts to balance the PMOS source current with the NMOS sink current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, power, common-mode gain, differential-mode rejection, and bandwidth of the CMFB detector.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMFB Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

XM1 N0 N0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 N0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

VVDD N2 0 1.8
VVDD_BULK VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS N1 0 0.6

VCM VCM_node 0 dc 1.2 ac 1
VDM VDM_node 0 dc 0 ac 0

E1 LABEL_NET_0 VCM_node VDM_node 0 0.5
E2 LABEL_NET_1 VCM_node VDM_node 0 -0.5

.control
  op
  let dc_power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8 - i(VVDD_BULK) * 1.8
  let v_out_dc = v(N0)
  print dc_power
  print v_out_dc

  * Common-Mode AC Analysis
  ac dec 10 1Meg 10G
  let cm_gain_db = vdb(N0)
  meas ac cm_gain_1M find cm_gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac cm_bw when cm_gain_db='cm_gain_1M - 3' fall=1

  * Differential-Mode AC Analysis
  alter VCM ac=0
  alter VDM ac=1
  ac dec 10 1Meg 10G
  let dm_gain_db = vdb(N0)
  meas ac dm_gain_1M find dm_gain_db at=1Meg
  
  quit
.endc
.end
